projects.name: Holocron
projects.tagline: The retro board that doesn’t keep your retros
projects.about: No accounts, no history, no archive. Create a board, share the six-character code and run the retro together: write, vote, discuss. Every board is a SQLite-backed Durable Object that pushes live updates over WebSockets and erases itself every morning.

meta.description: A retro board that doesn’t archive your retros

last_commit.message: Fix the WCAG 2.2 AA findings from the accessibility audit (#101)

projects.name: Datapad
projects.tagline: A private project tracker for an engineering leader
projects.about: Projects, tasks, notes, meetings, milestones and people in one place, with cross-project views, search and summaries that run on your own device. Holocron’s sibling: the same stack, look and quality bar, but it keeps your data and only you can reach it, behind Cloudflare Access.

meta.description: A private project tracker for an engineering leader

last_commit.message: MCP: read tools over the shared selectors (#216)

projects.name: Holotable
projects.about: Describe what you want to see and a language model authors a validated visualization spec (SQL and chart config), never the data itself. Holotable runs the guarded SQL against TimescaleDB and streams results live; Prometheus-compatible endpoints are sources too.

projects.name: Acolyte
projects.tagline: A toolbox for web developers’ day-to-day work
projects.about: API and WebSocket clients, SSE, JWT and Base64 tools, a JSON parser, Mermaid, SBOM and dependency analysis, a color picker and a few games, in one app. The everyday utilities, without a dozen browser tabs.

meta.description: An app designed to assist web developers in their day-to-day duties

last_commit.message: Bump @babel/core from 8.0.7 to 8.0.9 in the babel group (#221)

projects.name: johnnybouder.com
projects.tagline: A terminal-themed personal site with an assistant that answers
projects.about: Johnny Bouder’s portfolio: work, resume and socials from one data file, rendered server-side at the edge. The `>_ ask` launcher opens a chatbot that answers questions about Johnny from the same content.

last_commit.message: Move acolyte to just before pulse in selected work (#4)

projects.name: Music Visualizer
projects.tagline: A 2000s media-player visualizer in the browser
projects.about: A classic player window with a seven-segment clock over full-screen visuals: 23 scenes plus every bundled MilkDrop preset, each with a retro Canvas 2D counterpart. A static site, no backend, no accounts.

meta.description: Browser music visualizer: MilkDrop presets, WebGL 2 shader scenes and retro Canvas 2D effects

last_commit.message: Add a 10-band equalizer window and a screensaver mode

projects.name: Punchlist
projects.tagline: A team task tracker with one switch for every transition
projects.about: Built as the live demo for the talk “Modern Web Motion: Advanced Techniques, Everyday UI”. With motion on, it uses the platform’s current motion features; with motion off, every change is a cut, so you can judge what the motion is telling you.

meta.description: A small team task tracker with one switch that turns every transition on or off.

projects.name: Skills
projects.tagline: Coding-agent skills for scaffolding, conventions and review
projects.about: Claude Code skills that install into ~/.claude/skills: new-project scaffolds, frontend, backend and Kubernetes conventions, PR review, accessibility and web-app audits, talk decks and tool evaluations.

meta.description: My Collection of Coding Agent Skills

projects.name: Claude plugins
projects.tagline: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace
projects.about: Add the marketplace once and install any plugin from it: skills-sync keeps ~/.claude/skills in step with the repos your skills came from, and standup keeps a zero-token work journal that writes your yesterday and today.

last_commit.message: feat(skills-sync): bootstrap an empty manifest on first run; default add to newSkills=prompt

projects.name: Jean-Claude
projects.tagline: A Claude Code plugin with maximum impact
projects.about: The Muscles from Brussels for your local environment: kill processes and containers, regenerate a clean tree, split documents, and enter the Kumite. No retreat, no surrender.

meta.description: A Claude Code plugin that delivers fast, no-nonsense solutions with maximum impact.

last_commit.message: Update fight skill description in CLAUDE.md

projects.name: Agent Quest
projects.tagline: A Zelda-style control room for Claude Code agents
projects.about: Your repo is a village and your agents are villagers. Every NPC is a real Claude Code session: walk up to steer one, tap to interrupt, and watch its context window drain like a health bar.

last_commit.message: Say it once, let it be read, and open the pack from anywhere

projects.name: Chaos Lab
projects.tagline: Break a web app on purpose; an on-device assistant helps fix it
projects.about: Inject faults into Meridian, a small freight console backed by Mock Service Worker, and Dispatch, a model running locally on WebGPU, notices, explains and walks you through the fix. Nothing about an incident leaves the machine.

meta.homepage: WebLLM-driven playground for intercepting web failures

last_commit.message: Let the model do the talking, with the rules as grounding

projects.name: Motion Lab
projects.tagline: A playground for UI transitions and motion
projects.about: 53 togglable, tunable effects across eight categories: page transitions on the View Transitions API, component motion, scroll and text effects, particles and physics, and a retro wing.

meta.description: A playground for experimenting with motion and transitions

projects.name: Pulse
projects.tagline: Health and activity across these projects
projects.about: This dashboard. A daily GitHub Action snapshots each repo’s activity, stars, releases and traffic, plus Worker requests from Cloudflare, and commits the results as CSV, so the repo is the database.

meta.description: Health and activity across my projects
